planning_notes: No explicit pullup/active polarity for D2/D3 was provided; digital_input uses catalog default polarity/electrical configuration. Model true is interpreted as pressed to match 'do not invert an active-low pressed button again' rule; SysML must apply any needed inversion if hardware is active-low.
Serial commands are received via one serial_command_input using the provided baud/framing and exact command mapping; other serial inputs (integer/text) are not required by the given requirements.

A serial state-report was not specified in the prose; a minimal typed status report (COUNT and LIGHT_STATE) is added under an assumed periodic model-controlled trigger. If the SysML model already defines different report cadence/fields, adjust serial_channels accordingly.

Control/business logic (when to increment COUNT, how LIGHT_STATE maps to D13, and how COUNT_RESET interacts with the TM1637) is intentionally left to SysML; only the required electrical capabilities (D13 digital output, D6 tone output, TM1637 number on D4/D5, D2/D3 inputs, and serial command reception) are declared here.
TM1637 invalid behavior uses invalid_policy='blank'. Startup initial count is 0 because the inventory did not specify any nonzero initial count.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Local button D2: LIGHT_ON request gate (model true means pressed)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Local button D3: LIGHT_OFF request gate (model true means pressed)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LED D13: LIGHT_ON/LIGHT_OFF actuation (model true drives LED on)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Beeper: BEEP command generates tone frequency (Hz)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 displays累计操作次数 (count value from COUNT_RESET/LIGHT actions)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Serial commands: LIGHT_ON=6, LIGHT_OFF=5, BEEP=1, COUNT_RESET=3

interfaces.name: io_5_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Periodic state report gate (assumption: model sets this true on its own schedule)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Reported累计操作次数 (current counter value)
